_im2faded4this_: Walter This came up on Day 9 carrying news from Stoneyford. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Walter This helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F6. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Walter This felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk of the Hegemony (@karlczk1988). Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Walter This watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
anezka.sm: Nobody saw Ulrich "Owl" Anezka arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in P-F5, and a quiet sniper under it.

Ulrich "Owl" Anezka and Clement Alexquinn made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F5 with the rations. Ulrich "Owl" Anezka ate while listening to the revised orders.
berkaatilla: Marek Berkaatilla left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters.

Marek Berkaatilla jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Viktor Detroit. The Concord medics will be busy. (@major_detroit313) Marek Berkaatilla joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Marek Berkaatilla shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Marek Berkaatilla fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Konrad Erikvukk was gravely wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Marek Berkaatilla answered to number 662. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Marek Berkaatilla during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
chickenmcnugget2025: The draft reached S-C15 on Day 9. Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

A bullet struck Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug below the ribs at S-C15. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Walter "Mole" Dobremateico of the Concord (@dobremateiconstantin). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug died waiting. The men at S-C15 have not stopped talking about it.

Otto Chickenmcnug asked about Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug on arriving at S-C15. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Otto Chickenmcnug answered to number 970. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-C15 changed before the cheering ended. Otto Chickenmcnug shouldered another load.
eversonae: "You're late," said the corporal when Arno Eversonae arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Arno Eversonae stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Arno Eversonae borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Arno Eversonae read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
ghostrider_q3f: Benedikt Ghostrider arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a bullet that missed him and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A round went through the rim of Benedikt Ghostrider's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Jakub Marshall of the Hegemony (@marshall_n7). After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Benedikt Ghostrider helped stack spare sandbags at R-R16. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Benedikt Ghostrider's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-R16 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. Benedikt Ghostrider got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 983. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R16. Benedikt Ghostrider has learned to walk bent double.
gilbertjamesthe4th: After 9 days of war, S-C15 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames felt a hard tug at his hip at S-C15. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Gustav Burgosgeovan of the Concord (@burgosgeovanni). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames is number 984. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
gsh1ngles: After 9 days of war, R-R13 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Felix "Mole" Ngles.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R13 and grazed Felix "Mole" Ngles's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Norbert "Shadow" Slush of the Hegemony (@slush2083). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Felix "Mole" Ngles kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Three days with a bandage, and Felix "Mole" Ngles is back at R-R13. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Felix "Mole" Ngles is number 904. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Felix "Mole" Ngles read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
i_da_goat_fr: Severin "Mud" Goat came up on Day 10 carrying news from Halden. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Severin "Mud" Goat read a theatre review while peeling supper. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Severin "Mud" Goat during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
keaganwilson085: At the depot, Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson had practised answering to his name. At R-C10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A shell landed close to R-C10. When the dust settled Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson was still there, holding a frozen apple, laughing without sound. Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 615. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
lauri.joki: Clement "Mud" Joki arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Clement "Mud" Joki did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A parcel came for Clement "Mud" Joki that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: three pairs of woollen mittens. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Clement "Mud" Joki is number 628. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Clement "Mud" Joki watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
nekopatata: Viktor Nekopatata arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a stub of a pencil and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Ivo Cko of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at Grey Mill. Viktor Nekopatata of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Viktor Nekopatata read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
robertdpayneiv: Teodor "Button" Robertdpayne reached P-F9 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

A sniper's bullet hit Teodor "Button" Robertdpayne at P-F9. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Norbert "Bones" Primum of the Concord (@salutem_primum_). Teodor "Button" Robertdpayne was killed outright at P-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Norbert "Bones" Primum of the Concord (@salutem_primum_).

Silas Robertdpayne had heard about Teodor "Button" Robertdpayne's courage. At P-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Silas Robertdpayne helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
vikt.02: Lucien "Ghost" Vikt came from Tannenfeld, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-S10. Lucien "Ghost" Vikt has learned to walk bent double.

Lucien "Ghost" Vikt agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Lucien "Ghost" Vikt watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
wmacdon328: Pavel Wmacdon arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. Grey Mill has been won. Pavel Wmacdon listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
x0mb13_06: The old hands of T-F9 have been here since Day 1. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Across the wire at Calvary Farm, Cyril Bananaman of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Dorian "Lucky" Xmb of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.' The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into T-F9. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb has learned to walk bent double.
